층.forms: Sino-Korean number + 층: 일 층 · 삼 층 · 지하 일 층
층.x: The restroom is on the second floor.
층.e: 삼 층 = 3rd floor. 일 층 is the ground floor, like in the US.
층.t: Floors use Sino-Korean numbers. B1 = 지하 일 층. Ask: 몇 층이에요?

응원하다.m: to cheer (for), to root for, to support
응원하다.ex: 우리는 경기장에서 한국 팀을 열심히 응원했어요.
응원하다.x: We cheered hard for the Korean team at the stadium.
응원하다.e: Literally 'responding with help' — backing someone up.
응원하다.t: Also used for encouraging people in life: 항상 응원할게요 'I'll always be rooting for you.'

컵라면.x: Pour hot water into the cup noodles and wait just three minutes.
컵라면.t: Pronounced [컴나면]: the ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅂ, and the ㅂ then becomes ㅁ before that ㄴ. Convenience stores have hot-water dispensers and a counter, so people often eat it right there.

승진.x: My older brother was promoted to manager this year.
승진.t: Use (position)으로 승진하다: 과장으로 승진하다 'be promoted to manager'.

정부.x: The government announced a new transportation policy.

방해.x: The construction noise is getting in the way of my studying.

자원봉사자.ex: 이번 축제에는 자원봉사자가 이백 명 넘게 참가했어요.
자원봉사자.x: More than two hundred volunteers took part in this festival.
자원봉사자.e: Literally 'a person who serves by their own wish.' -자 = person who does it: 과학자, 운전자.

뚜렷하다.ex: 한국은 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울이 뚜렷한 나라예요.
뚜렷하다.x: Korea is a country with distinct spring, summer, fall, and winter seasons.
뚜렷하다.t: Pronounced [뚜려타다] — the final ㅅ and ㅎ merge into ㅌ.

전문적.e: Literally 'devoted to one gate' — focused on a single field.

집게.x: Please flip the meat with the tongs.
집게.e: 집다 'to pick up' + -게, an ending for tools.
집게.t: Pronounced [집께]: ㄱ becomes tense after ㅂ. At Korean BBQ restaurants each table gets tongs and scissors (가위) for cooking and cutting the meat.

심폐 소생술.ex: 쓰러진 사람에게 심폐 소생술을 해서 생명을 구했어요.
심폐 소생술.x: They saved a collapsed person's life by performing CPR.
심폐 소생술.e: Literally 'heart-lung revival technique'. -술 = skill, technique: 기술, 수술.

수험생.m: exam taker, test candidate (esp. for the college entrance exam)
수험생.ex: 수능 날 아침에 수험생들이 시험장으로 들어가고 있어요.
수험생.x: On the morning of the CSAT, test takers are heading into the exam halls.
수험생.t: Usually means high school seniors preparing for the 수능, though it works for any big exam.

오존층.ex: 오존층이 파괴되면 자외선이 더 많이 들어와요.
오존층.x: If the ozone layer is destroyed, more UV rays get in.

증인.ex: 그는 사고를 직접 본 증인으로 법정에 나왔어요.
증인.x: He appeared in court as a witness who saw the accident firsthand.

동참하다.m: to join in, to take part (in a shared cause)
동참하다.ex: 많은 시민이 환경 보호 캠페인에 동참했어요.
동참하다.x: Many citizens joined the environmental protection campaign.

짙다.x: The fog was so thick this morning that it was hard to drive.
짙다.e: Close in meaning to 진하다, but 짙다 is more native and often used for fog, shadows and makeup.

집권.m: taking power, holding power; rule (of a party or government)
집권.ex: 그 정당은 지난 선거에서 승리해 집권에 성공했습니다.
집권.x: That party won the last election and succeeded in taking power.
집권.t: 집권하다 means to take or hold power; 집권 여당 is the standard news term for the ruling party.

입찰.ex: 그 회사는 정부 공사 입찰에 참여했어요.
입찰.x: That company took part in the bidding for a government construction project.
입찰.e: Literally 'putting in a slip' — bids were written on slips.

성찰하다.x: At the end of the day, I reflect on my actions.
성찰하다.e: Literally 'examine and observe' — looking closely at yourself.
성찰하다.t: 성찰 is deep, philosophical self-examination; 반성 implies regret over a specific mistake.

미풍양속.m: good morals and manners, fine traditional customs
미풍양속.x: Respecting elders is one of our fine traditions.
미풍양속.t: Pronounced [미풍냥속] — an ㄴ sound is added before 양.

묵과하다.m: to let pass in silence, to tolerate, to turn a blind eye to
묵과하다.ex: 이런 부정행위는 절대 묵과할 수 없습니다.
묵과하다.x: This kind of misconduct can never be tolerated.
묵과하다.t: Unlike 간과하다 (not noticing), 묵과하다 means noticing but saying nothing.

등지다.m: to turn one's back on; to fall out with; to leave (one's hometown); to have at one's back
등지다.x: He turned his back on his hometown and came up to Seoul.
등지다.e: 등 'back' + 지다 'to carry on the back' — putting something behind you.
등지다.t: 세상을 등지다 is a euphemism for 'to pass away' or 'to withdraw from the world'.

송두리째.ex: 화재로 그는 모든 재산을 송두리째 잃었어요.
송두리째.x: He lost all his property in the fire.
송두리째.e: From 송두리 'the whole lot' plus -째 'as a whole', as in 통째로.
송두리째.t: Usually describes losing or changing everything: 삶을 송두리째 바꾸다 'to change one's life completely'.

집회.ex: 주말에 시청 앞에서 대규모 집회가 열렸어요.
집회.x: A large rally was held in front of city hall over the weekend.
집회.t: Pronounced [지푀] — ㅂ and ㅎ merge into ㅍ.

경범죄.ex: 길에 쓰레기를 버리면 경범죄로 벌금을 낼 수 있어요.
경범죄.x: If you litter on the street, you can be fined for a minor offense.

송출.ex: 기술적인 문제로 방송 송출이 잠시 중단되었습니다.
송출.x: The broadcast transmission was briefly interrupted due to a technical problem.

명심하다.m: to keep in mind, to take to heart
명심하다.x: I'll always keep your words in mind, teacher.
명심하다.t: Often used as an instruction: 명심하세요, 'Remember this well.'

집단 감염.x: A cluster outbreak occurred at a nursing hospital.
집단 감염.t: Pronounced [집딴 가몀]. News phrasing: 집단 감염이 발생하다 'an outbreak occurs'.

법관.ex: 법관은 법과 양심에 따라 독립하여 재판합니다.
법관.x: Judges rule independently according to the law and their conscience.

경험론.x: Locke is the philosopher who represents British empiricism.

병소.ex: 의사는 수술로 병소를 완전히 제거했다고 말했습니다.
병소.x: The doctor said the affected site had been completely removed in surgery.
병소.e: Literally 'disease nest' — where the illness lives in the body.

정물화.ex: 미술 시간에 사과와 꽃병으로 정물화를 그렸어요.
정물화.x: In art class we painted a still life of apples and a vase.

장원.m: first place in the state exam; top scorer
장원.x: He passed the state exam in first place.
장원.t: A different 장원 means a medieval manor; in exam contexts it always means top scorer.

와신상담.m: enduring hardship to get revenge or reach a goal
와신상담.ex: 작년의 패배 이후 그는 와신상담 끝에 우승했어요.
와신상담.x: After last year's defeat, he endured hardship and finally won the title.
와신상담.e: Literally 'sleeping on firewood, tasting gall' — ancient kings keeping their grudge alive.
와신상담.t: Common in sports news for a comeback after a painful loss.

회자정리.ex: 회자정리라지만 친구와 헤어지는 건 늘 슬퍼요.
회자정리.x: They say all who meet must part, but leaving friends is always sad.
회자정리.e: A Buddhist teaching: 'those who meet are bound to part'.
회자정리.t: Pronounced [회자정니]; often paired with 거자필반 'those who leave will return'.

징발하다.m: to requisition, to commandeer (goods or people by the state)
징발하다.ex: 전쟁 중 군대는 민간 차량을 징발했습니다.
징발하다.x: During the war, the army requisitioned civilian vehicles.
징발하다.e: Literally 'levy and send out' — the state taking property or labor in emergencies.

나지막하다.m: rather low; low and soft (of a voice)
나지막하다.ex: 그는 나지막한 목소리로 비밀을 말해 주었어요.
나지막하다.x: He told me the secret in a low, soft voice.

이분법.ex: 세상을 선과 악의 이분법으로 볼 수는 없어요.
이분법.x: You can't see the world as a simple split between good and evil.
이분법.e: Literally 'the method of dividing in two'.

정저지와.m: a frog in a well, a person with a narrow view
정저지와.ex: 해외 경험이 없으면 정저지와가 되기 쉬워요.
정저지와.x: Without overseas experience, it's easy to become a frog in a well.
정저지와.e: Literally 'frog at the bottom of a well,' who thinks the sky is a small circle.
정저지와.t: In everyday speech Koreans say 우물 안 개구리 instead.
